question: Select the most appropriate option for blank(2)
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **to**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition** 'to'** is used here to indicate the direction in which something is going.

 
 
• For example: This video is going to hit 1 million.
 
 
 
• Similarly, in this context, it is said that the total number of infections (measles) is going to become nine million.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **to**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Upon** (पर): Used to indicate a position on a surface or a condition or event.

 
 
• **Example:** The cat jumped upon the table.
 
 
 
• **Too** (भी): Used to indicate excessiveness or in addition.
 
 
• **Example:** It is too hot to go outside today.
 
 
 
• **In** (में): Used to indicate inclusion within space, a place, or a time period.
 
 
• **Example:** She is in the garden.
